zh: 我们的房东又要涨房租了。
en: Our {landlord} is putting the rent up again.

zh: 之前的租客把房子弄得一团糟。
en: The previous {tenants} left the place in a mess.

zh: 我们为这套公寓签了十二个月的租约。
en: We signed a twelve-month {lease} on the flat.

zh: 厨房的水龙头滴了一整夜的水。
en: The kitchen {tap|faucet} has been dripping all night.

zh: 剪刀在厨房的某个抽屉里。
en: The scissors are in one of the kitchen {drawers}.

zh: 我在客房的墙上装了几块搁板。
en: I put up some {shelves} on the wall in the spare room.

zh: 今晚很冷，床上再加一条毯子吧。
en: It's cold tonight, so put an extra {blanket} on the bed.

zh: 这个周末我得修剪草坪了。
en: I need to mow the {lawn|grass} this weekend.

zh: 把取暖器打开吧，屋里冷死了。
en: Turn the {heater} on, it's freezing in here.

zh: 垃圾桶要在周二晚上推到路边去。
en: The {bins} need to go out on the kerb on Tuesday night.

zh: 你每周付多少房租？
en: How much {rent} do you pay a week?

zh: 我把钥匙锁在屋里了。
en: I've locked my {keys} inside the house.

zh: 每次下大雨，屋顶都会漏水。
en: The {roof} leaks every time it rains heavily.

zh: 卧室的天花板上有一块受潮的痕迹。
en: There's a damp patch on the bedroom {ceiling}.

zh: 你能把窗帘拉上吗？太阳晃我的眼睛。
en: Could you close the {curtains|blinds}? The sun is in my eyes.

zh: 我每周换一次床单。
en: I change the {sheets} on our bed once a week.

zh: 我们得买张新床垫了，这张睡得我腰疼。
en: We need a new {mattress}; this one hurts my back.

zh: 把你的大衣挂在衣柜里。
en: Hang your coat up in the {wardrobe|closet}.

zh: 杯子在水壶上面的橱柜里。
en: The mugs are in the {cupboard} above the kettle.

zh: 厨房的水槽又堵了，水下不去。
en: The kitchen {sink} is blocked again and the water won't drain.

zh: 冰箱里除了一瓶芥末酱什么都没有。
en: There's nothing in the {fridge|refrigerator} but a jar of mustard.

zh: 烤箱预热需要十分钟。
en: The {oven} takes ten minutes to heat up.

zh: 上下楼梯要小心，很陡。
en: Be careful on the {stairs|steps}; they're very steep.

zh: 邻居家的狗跳过了栅栏，跑进了我们的花园。
en: The dog next door jumped over the {fence} into our garden.

zh: 轮到你把洗好的衣服晾出去了。
en: It's your turn to hang out the {laundry|washing}.

zh: 我们平分家务活。
en: We split the household {chores} evenly.

zh: 你洗碗的话，我就做饭。
en: I'll cook if you do the {dishes}.

zh: 你能把垃圾拿出去倒了吗？
en: Can you take out the {rubbish|trash|garbage}?

zh: 客人来之前，我用吸尘器把客厅吸了一遍。
en: I ran the {vacuum|hoover} around the lounge before the guests arrived.

zh: 有人把红酒洒在地毯上了。
en: Someone spilled red wine on the {carpet|rug}.

zh: 浴室的墙上长霉了。
en: There's {mould|mold} growing on the bathroom wall.

zh: 我们发现洗衣机后面有个漏水的地方，地板都湿透了。
en: We found a {leak} behind the washing machine, and the floor was soaked.

zh: 只要一放热水，那些旧水管就砰砰作响。
en: The old {pipes} make a banging noise whenever we run hot water.

zh: 我们叫了个水管工来修马桶。
en: We called a {plumber} to fix the toilet.

zh: 这套公寓配齐了所有的厨房电器。
en: The flat comes with all the kitchen {appliances}.

zh: 我们大部分家具都是买的二手货。
en: We bought most of our {furniture} second-hand.

zh: 我和三个室友合租这栋房子。
en: I share the house with three {flatmates|housemates|roommates}.

zh: 只要房子打扫干净，搬走时我们就能拿回押金。
en: We'll get our {bond|deposit} back when we move out, as long as the place is clean.

zh: 物业经理周五要来做房屋检查。
en: The property manager is doing a house {inspection} on Friday.

zh: 这里的老房子冬天特别冷，因为墙里没有保温层。
en: Old houses here are freezing in winter because there's no {insulation} in the walls.

zh: 床边有没有插座可以给手机充电？
en: Is there a {socket|plug|outlet|power point} near the bed where I can charge my phone?

zh: 厨房里有两个灯泡烧坏了。
en: Two of the light {bulbs} in the kitchen have blown.

zh: 请把鞋子放在门口的走廊里。
en: Please leave your shoes in the {hallway|hall} by the front door.

zh: 昨晚我们在屋后的木露台上烧烤。
en: We had a barbecue out on the back {deck} last night.

zh: 厨房的翻新装修花了六个月，还花了一大笔钱。
en: The kitchen {renovations|renovation} took six months and cost a lot of money.

zh: 屋檐的排水槽里全是落叶，需要清理了。
en: The {gutters} are full of leaves and need cleaning out.

zh: 浴室的柜子里有干净的毛巾。
en: There are clean {towels} in the bathroom cabinet.

zh: 暴风雨期间停电了，我们只好点蜡烛。
en: The {power|electricity} went out during the storm, so we lit some candles.

zh: 卧室里没有足够的空间放书桌。
en: There isn't enough {space|room} for a desk in the bedroom.

zh: 门把手被我一拉就掉了。
en: The door {handle} came off in my hand.
